parsed.post: Discarding 1.0042; the halving of TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE (to 262144) resulted in a slight regression from my best 1.0021. It seems the decreased gradient stability or fewer parameters per step offset the gain from more optimizer steps. Reverting to 262144 was a mistake; I'll return to the previous best configuration and try increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.08.
parsed.description: Reverting TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 524288 and increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.08 to seek better convergence speed while maintaining stability.
